name: state_machine
description: Deterministic finite state machine tracking execution state across lifecycle phases. Same inputs produce the same state transitions (Constitution Principle 4). State persists per session via the memory module so a paused request resumes deterministically.

inputs.name: request_id
inputs.description: AIOS-REQ-NNNNNN identifying the execution whose state is queried or advanced.

inputs.name: event
inputs.description: Event that drives a transition: { type, payload }. If omitted, returns current state only.

outputs.name: state
outputs.description: One of: idle, understanding, discovering, analyzing, researching, simulating, planning, implementing, validating, testing, reviewing, documenting, completed, failed, paused.

outputs.name: transitions
outputs.description: History of { from, to, event_type, at, gate_result } for this request — the audit trail required by Engineering Law 13.

side_effects: Persists state and transition history to the memory module (AIOS-MODULE-000006)

error_codes.message: The event is not a valid transition from the current state.
error_codes.recovery: Reject the event; log the attempted from->to pair; keep the current state.
Initialize state to idle for the request and proceed, or report an unknown request.

error_codes.message: Memory module refused to persist state.
error_codes.recovery: Fail gracefully per Engineering Law 9; continue in-memory and surface a degraded-capability warning.

examples: state=planning + event={type:plan_approved} -> state=implementing; recorded in transitions.
